add.name: pre-mortem
add.purpose: Runs a pre-mortem on a PRD or launch plan, sorting risks into Tigers, Paper Tigers and Elephants, then into launch-blocking, fast-follow or track.
add.how_to_use: Use before launches or PRD sign-off; give it the PRD or plan.
add.evidence: phuryn/pm-skills 26.7k stars; skills.sh ~9.8k installs (one of the top 'prd' results)

checked: skills.sh search API (queries per topic, by installs); skillsmp.com API (sortBy=stars); gh api tree/contents verification; queries: product-manager, prd, roadmap, user-story, jira, spec, product-spec, okr, experiment; skillsmp: 'product manager', prd

Skipped: warpdotdev write-product-spec (27k installs but written specifically for Warp's own repo), deanpeters skills (NOASSERTION license, roadmap/user-story already covered), mattpocock to-prd (already listed as to-spec).
